maya: FYI discovered an accidental bulk export this morning that contained ~18 months of auth events. Export landed in a temporary bucket without PII tokenization.

priya: How did it run? automated job or manual? which svc-account?

maya: Manual run by svc-siem-agent (assumed via ops-console). Job id EX-2026-03-23-9001. Size ~130GB, ~1.2M rows. Logs: https://logs.internal/exports/EX-2026-03-23-9001

tom: I saw a large egress + a KMS unwrap at 05:14 UTC. Looks like the export used older CMK that was scheduled for rotation later today.

maya: Root causes: 1) export tool allowed unaudited manual runs; 2) service account had wide kms:Decrypt + s3:PutObject permissions; 3) destination bucket wasn't in approved list.

ben: Legal: we need chain-of-custody and to know if any customer PII was included. If yes, mandatory notification thresholds may apply.

priya: Quick mitigation plan: revoke svc-siem-agent credentials, quarantine the bucket (block public and cross-account access), rotate CMK, and snapshot export artifact for forensics (write-once).

maya: Short-term actions done: creds revoked, bucket policy tightened, CMK rotation started. Still need audit trail and approved workflow.

priya: Proposal for longer term workflow: - Exports only via export-api which returns ephemeral role ARN (assume-role-for-duration) after 2 approvers. - export-api enforces redaction policies (sample / tokenize / scrub) by default. - kms-proxy unwraps logged to immutable audit-store.

maya: Example request payload we discussed:\n```json\n{"requester":"maya","datasets":["auth-events"],"reason":"legal/investigation EX-9001","timebox_minutes":120,"redaction":"tokenize_pii","max_rows":500000}\n```

priya: Detection & guardrails: auto-block exports that: a) touch >90 days of history without legal flag, b) exceed 50GB, or c) write to non-approved buckets. Add SIEM rule 'export_volume_threshold' to create INFSEC ticket automatically.

tom: IAM change: create ephemeral role template (ExportRole-{id}) with explicit s3:PutObject on approved buckets only, and a condition requiring aws:RequestTag/export_request_id. Deny s3:PutObject for any principal not assuming ephemeral roles. Default TTL 2h, can escalate to 12h with SRE approval.

ben: For legal: require chain-of-custody header on every request and preserve a tamper-evident audit blob (hash + KMS-sealed metadata). Also need customer-notification threshold: if export contains >500 unique customer ids or contains untokenized PII, legal must be notified.

audit-bot: export_record created id=EX-2026-03-23-9001 by maya. status=pending_review

priya: kms-proxy logging required lines:\n```\nkms-proxy: unwrap id=EX-2026-03-23-9001 requester=maya dataset=auth-events outcome=success cmk=arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd\n```\nSend these to audit-store with high retention and WORM if possible.

maya: Also: default sampling for ad-hoc exports set to 1% unless full dump justified. Helps reduce blast radius and cost.

priya: Detection addition: if any export is >30d of backfill OR >100GB OR >1M rows, auto-pause and require manual approval from security+legal.

tom: I'll open a PR for the IAM guardrail and a bucket quarantine CloudFormation change.

maya: I'll draft an RFC describing export-api, ephemeral roles, audit-store schema, and bucket whitelist. Target: 2 week sprint to implement guardrails.

ben: Legal will prepare notification templates and chain-of-custody checklist. Also confirm retention/ttl for quarantine snapshot.

priya: I'll add SIEM detection rule and a smoke test that simulates a large export. Will also add alert runbook to create INFSEC ticket and assign reviewers.

maya: Owners: infra/tom, security/priya & maya, legal/ben. File INFSEC ticket INFSEC-789 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFSEC-789. Please update with PR links and timeline.

audit-bot: export_record EX-2026-03-23-9001 status update: approvals=0/2

priya: One more: exports that include >90 days of login events must set forensics_preserve=true which writes the audit blob to WORM storage and requires two-person release.

maya: Thanks everyone  We'll aim to close the mitigation and land the IAM PR this week. :lock: :white_check_mark:
